description: Read from the clipboard, summarize it, send its contents via messaging, or write new content to the clipboard.

action.description: What to do: 'read' returns clipboard text, 'summarize' gives an AI summary, 'send' sends via WhatsApp/email, 'copy' writes new content

platform.description: Platform to send clipboard content on

content.description: For 'copy' action: the text to write to clipboard

example_commands: send clipboard to Rahul on WhatsApp
